title: Android from the foundation
intro: Lifecycle, process death, ANRs, Context leaks: most of Android's hard parts come from one idea. This course builds that idea up one small puzzle at a time, with diagrams you click through, until the rest stops being a list of rules and starts making sense.
how: Each puzzle starts with a problem Android had to solve, then gives you one building block, a picture to remember it by, and a diagram you step through. It ends with a few questions: try to answer before you open them. Every puzzle builds on the one before, so go in order.

modules.title: Module 1: How your app really runs
modules.blurb: Processes, the runtime, Zygote, system_server, Binder and the main thread: the four characters every later puzzle uses.

upcoming.title: Module 2: Screens and their lives
upcoming.topics: Context, Intents, PendingIntent, the Activity lifecycle, tasks and the back stack, process death and saved state.

upcoming.title: Module 3: Work without a screen
upcoming.topics: Services, broadcasts, ContentProviders and startup order, Doze and WorkManager, permissions.

upcoming.title: Module 4: Threads, coroutines and Flow
upcoming.topics: What really runs where, cancellation and errors, cold and hot streams.

upcoming.title: Module 5: Pixels and performance
upcoming.topics: How a frame gets on screen, Compose internals, memory and leaks, startup and jank.
